title: Surreal Moonlit Menagerie
description: Three dark blue boars with glowing eyes stand on a sandy dune beside a massive twisted tree that morphs into an ornate long-necked creature with a large eye. In the background a gothic castle glows with lights under a starry night sky containing two large moons.
prompt: Surreal night scene featuring three dark blue boars with glowing eyes standing on a sandy dune next to a massive twisted tree that transforms into a long-necked creature with an ornate head and large glowing eye. Distant gothic castle with lit windows sits under a deep blue starry sky containing two large luminous moons, one significantly larger than the other, in a dreamlike fantasy style.
